system.description:
At 20th level, you and your companion reach the pinnacle of your abilities. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.Sa5glc33WIZnv67t]{Stewardship} ability to guard your companion, you take half the damage and your companion takes no damage. @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.PbIdszgledG9FrbB]{Raise The Bar} no longer requires the same type of d20 roll. Finally, you may use your @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.NcLeDGkk31szxWBQ]{Careful Coordination} at will instead of requiring rests.

In addition, your companion gains 4hd, reaching 12 hit dice, and gains their final ability determined by their companion type.
